entries.06f0c403e4ce6c5f: This category mainly covers system development-related services, limousine services for affluent customers, land operations for inbound foreign tourists, social welfare services such as home-visit care and group home management, and online customer service. It is not included in the reportable segments. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥3,044 million.
entries.18d89c48674772ea: Under outsourcing agreements, this business contracts from telecommunications carriers, manufacturers and others for the entire range of sales operations, from planning sales strategy, marketing, building sales systems, arranging staff, training, in-store sales and sales management. As 'Results-Driven Sales Support', an operations office is set up for each client, and trained staff handle sales on the floor. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥25,831 million, the largest business in the Group.
entries.3bc58df1ed686231: Under worker dispatch contracts, this business dispatches staff matched to client needs to telecommunications carriers, manufacturers, supermarkets and general merchandise stores (GMS), travel agencies and other businesses. It draws on sales know-how and training and education systems developed in the outsourcing business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥8,786 million.
entries.4ec93612198837e7: It provides social welfare services, including operating home-visit care and group homes.
entries.5033c00f216254cd: It handles apparel and miscellaneous goods consistently from planning and design through manufacturing, production management and wholesale, and sells them to major retailers in Japan and overseas.
entries.53d86aab4a36c41f: Acting as an intermediary between TV direct-response sales companies and apparel manufacturers, it supports brand building, product planning, production management, and presentations during on-air broadcasts.
entries.63f109d789e181f6: From airlines, it contracts ground handling services such as aircraft guidance, passenger check-in and guidance, and loading and unloading of baggage and cargo. It also operates duty-free counters for inbound foreign visitors, multilingual call centers, and exhibitions and sports events, among others.
entries.9201c1ca9e7ad4c6: It provides limousine services for affluent customers and land operations for inbound foreign tourists.
entries.9cad8c80dcb9601f: Apparel and Goods Planning, Manufacturing and Wholesale
entries.a5c16bb47745594d: It provides system development-related services and online customer service.
entries.a8e69aeb0d3e868f: It dispatches sales staff for smartphones, large-screen TVs, household appliances, fresh food and other products. It also dispatches staff for call centers, sales administration, trade administration, accounting administration and other roles.
entries.b0a68fb879fe6c69: System Development and Online Customer Service
entries.c449abff1f4963e9: Dispatch of Sales Staff and Others
entries.ce61ec21a8e695d7: It dispatches tour conductors and bus guides for domestic and overseas travel, and staff for duty-free counters and other roles.
entries.ceb5f5f25c05cb3e: This business provides the full range of planning, design, manufacturing, production management and wholesale of apparel and miscellaneous goods for major domestic and overseas retailers. Working with brands, content holders and influencers, it enhances the added value of products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥16,679 million.
entries.d53ccb97907e9edb: A holding company centered on sales support and staffing, undertaking sales operations for telecom carriers and manufacturers, which also handles EC operation support and wholesale of clothing.
entries.e575d6b70d46b98f: Airport Ground Handling and Other Services
entries.f2feddc67cadf70b: From planning and development of official EC sites for brands and the like through order management, product procurement, delivery and payment collection, it handles the entire range of business operations required for EC. The main focus is on the fashion and sports fields.
entries.fb44e928cca15d79: Centered on in-person sales of smartphones, household appliances, fresh food, cosmetics and fashion, among others, it handles everything from sales planning to feeding back customer needs after sales. It also provides inside sales using call centers and sales support for door-to-door sales related to introducing cashless payment.
